verdicts.reason: A reads well left to right: the quote and attribution share a left edge and the quote mark sits deliberately on its circle. Its flaws are that the attribution is oversized and competes with the headline, the SOLSTICE logo floats loosely between the text and the product, the can sits high in its circle rather than centred, and the label on the can is unreadable. B is broken: the attribution is jammed against the left edge, does not line up with the quote, and runs across the edge of the big grey circle. The quote mark floats on its own, the logo is stranded in the middle, and the circle behind the can is cut off at the top and bottom, so the whole layout looks scattered.
